description:
Mechanical prerequisite for all other tickets. Every component that currently returns {self, [binary()], frame_ms} is updated to return {self, %VLines{lines: lines}, frame_ms}. Behavior is identical — VLines wraps the same bytes. The Transcript, interactive.ex, and build_screen are updated to work with VNodes throughout.

Changes:
- transcript.ex: cache type annotation %{id() => VDOM.t()}, render/2 typespec, do_render cache stores vnode not lines, replace lines_only/1 with as_vflow/1
- interactive.ex: add vnode_height/2 helper, add render_ctx/1 helper, rewrite build_screen main clause to assemble %VFlow{} tree and call Paint.paint once, update render_transcript/2 signature (transcript, ctx) → {VDOM.t(), transcript}, update send_render to pass input_vnode
- All components in apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/ plus transcript entries (AssistantHeader, AssistantStatus, UserMessage, TextBlock, ThinkingBlock, ToolExecution, etc.): change {self, lines, frame_ms} → {self, %VLines{lines: lines}, frame_ms}

Key helpers to add to interactive.ex:
  defp vnode_height(vnode, ctx), do: Paint.paint(vnode, LineBuf.new(), ctx).line_count
  defp render_ctx(state), do: %OctoPi.TUI.RenderContext{theme: state.theme, width: state.width, padding_x: 1, hide_thinking: not state.thinking_visible, hidden_thinking_label: "Thinking..."}

New build_screen assembles %VFlow{children: [header, loaded_resources, transcript_vnode, loader, pending_messages, input_vnode, dropdown_vnode, notif_vnode, footer_vnode]}, calls Paint.paint once, splits iodata to lines, computes layout via vnode_height.

Invariants to preserve:
- build_screen returns {[binary()], %{footer_height:, dropdown_height:, notification_height:}, state}
- transcript cache mutation: state = %{state | transcript: transcript2} at interactive.ex:1982
- custom_widget bypass clause at line 1959 left untouched

Tests: mix compile clean. mix test green. mix pi in tmux — screen renders identically.
title: Component contract migration: render/2 returns VNode
